sections.title: Healthcare and Insurance (Humana)
sections.description: Humana (Louisville HQ) is one of the US's largest health insurance companies — 17+ million members, Medicare Advantage market leadership.

blocks.heading: Medicare Advantage population health
paragraphs: ML for Humana's large MA membership — risk adjustment model calibration, care gap identification, and chronic disease management prioritization for Humana's largest insurance product.

blocks.heading: Value-based care analytics
paragraphs: ML for Humana's provider value-based contracts — predicting quality measure performance, identifying high-risk members for care management, and optimizing the actuarial models underlying Humana's MA rate bids.

blocks.heading: Claims fraud detection
paragraphs: ML for Humana's claims integrity programs — detecting aberrant billing patterns, upcoding, and organized fraud schemes in Humana's Medicare and commercial claims streams.

sections.title: Bourbon and Spirits Industry
sections.description: Kentucky produces 95% of the world's bourbon — Louisville is the bourbon capital.

blocks.heading: Bourbon aging analytics
paragraphs: ML predicting bourbon barrel maturation outcomes from distillation parameters, warehouse position, and seasonal temperature cycles — enabling distillers to optimize barrel placement and predict optimal release timing for their aged whisky inventory.

blocks.heading: Production quality AI
paragraphs: Process control ML for bourbon distillation — fermentation monitoring, distillate quality prediction, and barrel entry proof optimization for Louisville's large distilleries (Brown-Forman, Heaven Hill, Beam Suntory's Kentucky operations).

blocks.heading: Demand forecasting for luxury spirits
paragraphs: ML for the growing premium and super-premium bourbon market — predicting demand for limited releases and allocated products for Louisville's large bourbon brand portfolio.

sections.title: Logistics (UPS Worldport)
sections.description: UPS Worldport at Louisville International Airport — the world's largest automated package sorting facility, processing 416,000+ packages per hour.

blocks.heading: Package sortation optimization
paragraphs: ML for UPS Worldport's enormous sorting operations — package flow routing, exception management, and throughput optimization for the facility that handles the majority of UPS's overnight and second-day air package volumes.

blocks.heading: Louisville air network analytics
paragraphs: Demand forecasting and capacity planning for UPS's Louisville-centered air network — predicting volume surges and optimizing aircraft utilization.

sections.title: Manufacturing (GE Appliances)
sections.description: GE Appliances (Louisville HQ, Haier subsidiary) manufactures refrigerators, dishwashers, washing machines, and ranges at Louisville's Appliance Park.

blocks.heading: Appliance manufacturing quality
paragraphs: CV for appliance production quality inspection at GE Appliances' Louisville manufacturing operations.

blocks.heading: Supply chain demand forecasting
paragraphs: ML for household appliance demand incorporating housing starts, appliance replacement cycles, and energy efficiency incentive program effects.

sections.title: Specialty Healthcare (Kindred)
sections.description: Kindred Healthcare (Louisville HQ) — the US's largest specialty hospital and rehabilitation company.

blocks.heading: Post-acute care outcome prediction
paragraphs: ML for Kindred's long-term acute care hospitals (LTACHs) and rehabilitation facilities — predicting patient functional recovery, discharge readiness, and care escalation risk.

blocks.heading: Clinical staff scheduling analytics
paragraphs: ML for Kindred's complex staffing requirements at specialty hospitals where patient acuity varies substantially from day to day.

sections.title: Louisville's AI investment trajectory
sections.description: Louisville's technology community is expanding beyond its healthcare and logistics anchors.

blocks.heading: Humana's AI investment ambitions
paragraphs: Humana has been among the most public US health insurance companies about its AI investment — the company's focus on home health, pharmacy, and Medicare Advantage AI has created substantial data science investment in Louisville that is beginning to attract non-Humana healthcare AI investment as well.

blocks.heading: Louisville's bourbon-tech intersection
paragraphs: The bourbon industry's growing interest in technology — precision aging, blockchain provenance tracking, and data-driven blend development — has created a bourbon-tech startup community in Louisville that is beginning to commercialize distillery analytics AI.

blocks.heading: UPS's technology modernization
paragraphs: UPS's ongoing investment in automation and analytics for Worldport is one of Louisville's most significant technology investments — the company's investment in robotics, automation, and predictive analytics for the world's most complex automated package sort facility is ongoing and substantial.
